description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It extends ListActivity to display a list of cheeses using a custom adapter, MyAdapter, which is an inner class extending BaseAdapter. The file manages the creation and display of a list with custom layout.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity that displays a list of cheeses, extending ListActivity.

classes.name: MyAdapter
classes.description: Inner class adapter that supplies cheese data to the ListView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and attaches the custom list adapter.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of cheese items.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the cheese item at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for the cheese at the specified position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view for each list item and sets the cheese name.
